name: JotBox Nigerian golden set
description: Private clips, 30 to 90 seconds each, with human-typed transcripts. Audio stays on this machine and is gitignored.

pidgin.label: Heavy Pidgin and code-switching
pidgin.recording: Two or three people talking naturally in Pidgin, switching into English for work terms.

far_field.label: Far field and room noise
far_field.recording: Phone across the table or on a shelf, fan or generator running, people at the edge of the room.

jargon.label: Nigerian names, acronyms, amounts
jargon.recording: Names like Oluwaseun, Chiamaka and Nkemdirim, acronyms like NIP, CBN, KYC and NHIS, amounts and dates.

fast.label: Fast chat and cross-talk
fast.recording: People interrupting each other, quick back and forth, laughter and overlapping turns.

noise.label: Silence and pure noise
noise.recording: 20 to 45 seconds of room tone, fan, traffic or a generator with no speech. The reader must return no words.
